stops.title: The church begins in Jerusalem
stops.text: The risen Jesus ascends, the Spirit comes at Pentecost, and the first believers share life together in Jerusalem.

stops.title: Saul meets the risen Jesus
stops.text: On the road to Damascus, Saul the persecutor is stopped by a light and a voice.

stops.title: The first Gentile church
stops.text: In Syrian Antioch followers of Jesus are first called Christians, and the church sends out Barnabas and Saul.

stops.title: The gospel reaches Europe
stops.text: Paul and Silas meet Lydia, are beaten and jailed, and the jailer believes.

stops.title: Paul in Athens
stops.text: Paul speaks to the philosophers on the Areopagus about the unknown god.

stops.title: A year and a half in Corinth
stops.text: Paul works with Aquila and Priscilla and stays among the Corinthians.

stops.title: Three years in Ephesus
stops.text: Paul's work in Ephesus spreads through the province and provokes a riot over the goddess Artemis.

stops.title: Held in Caesarea
stops.text: Paul is held for two years under the governors Felix and Festus and appeals to Caesar.

stops.title: Paul reaches Rome
stops.text: After a storm and shipwreck, Paul arrives in Rome and preaches openly under guard.
